title: Assistant
description: Review company data and create approved drafts.
welcomeDetail: Ask about stock, balances or open orders, or request a document draft.
offline: You are offline. Reconnect to continue.
requestError: The request could not be completed. Refresh the conversation and retry.
budgetError: Daily token budget or request limit reached. Try again later.
accessError: You do not have current access to this operation.
conflictError: Conversation busy or awaiting approval. Refresh the history.
failedMessage: The response did not complete. Continue from the saved history.
draftOnly: Approval only creates a draft; it does not post or make payments.
resolveApproval: Approve or reject the pending draft before sending another message.
disabled: Assistant disabled. No data is sent to an AI provider.
notConfigured: Assistant enabled but provider and model configuration is incomplete.
setupDetail: Your server administrator can add a provider key to secure environment variables and configure these settings.
setupSecrets: Do not enter keys here or in conversations. See the project Assistant documentation.
privacyDetail: A local provider can be used. Your administrator controls provider selection and data sharing.
adminDescription: Assistant status and token consumption by user for the current company.
noUsage: No usage in this date range.
